mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop_info (destination_id, closed_days, opening_hours, main_products, parking_available, contact_number, homepage_url, guide) VALUES (#{destinationId}, #{closedDays}, #{openingHours}, #{mainProducts}, #{parkingAvailable}, #{contactNumber}, #{homepageUrl}, #{guide})
mapper.update: UPDATE shop_info SET closed_days = #{closedDays}, opening_hours = #{openingHours}, main_products = #{mainProducts}, parking_available = #{parkingAvailable}, contact_number = #{contactNumber}, homepage_url = #{homepageUrl}, guide = #{guide} WHERE destination_id = #{destinationId}
